section_summary.extract_value: This section details the sample recruitment for a single study, which utilized Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to gather data. Participants were required to be U.S. residents, at least 18 years old, and English-speaking. The final sample consisted of 1,276 respondents with an average age of 34.56 years, and demographic information regarding gender, race, marital status, education, and employment is provided.
section_summary.evidence_source: Data were collected through Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk), an online marketplace for work. Using MTurk, researchers can pay participants a small amount to complete questionnaires. Prior research has suggested that MTurk is a rapid, inexpensive, and relatively reliable way to collect data from a diverse population (Buhrmester, Kwang, & Gosling, 2011). Participants in the current study completed an online questionnaire posted to MTurk. To qualify for the study, participants were required to be living in the United States, at least 18 years old, and able to read English. Qualifications were determined using self-report. The final sample included 1,276 respondents (M_{\text{age}} = 34.56 \text{ years}, 67% female, 82% White, 54% married/with partner). Additionally, 53% had received a 4-year college degree or above, another 38% has completed some college or a 2-year college degree, and 88% were currently employed. Of those employed, 23% reported that they held a management position.
